verdict.rationale: LaunchDarkly has a first-party CLI (ldcli) documented on its getting-started docs, and a probe independently confirmed the official CLI documentation page exists. The evidence establishes that the CLI exists but says nothing about what it does. missing for 10: detail on CLI commands and coverage (flags, environments, etc.), evidence of AI/agent-oriented workflows or scripting use, independent or hands-on corroboration of CLI usage.
